name: revenant
description: Build and deploy apps into your own AWS account from chat. Say "build me X": Revenant writes the spec, builds a preview, publishes it, and repairs failed deploys.
author: Revenant
highlights: "Build me X" in chat creates a Revenant project and returns its spec link
Build, publish and status tools that call your own Revenant install
A notification when a build, deploy or repair finishes
A page listing every project with its status and cost
useCases: Ask for a small internal app in chat and have it built and deployed in your own AWS account.
Get told in Kiro Crew when a deploy died and when Revenant brought it back.
configuration: Install Revenant in your AWS account and create an API token under Settings -> Kiro Crew.
Add REVENANT_URL and REVENANT_API_TOKEN under Settings -> Secrets.
Grant both secrets to the revenant-monitor schedule and resume it.

crons.name: revenant-monitor
crons.message: Report finished Revenant builds, deploys and repairs
